verdict_reason: Sentinel-2, CLMS HRL Imperviousness, CORINE and EuroCrops are open, free and fetchable; EU coverage confirmed (EuroCrops covers 17/27 states). No source records which parcels were sealed or had soil removed: Imperviousness Change is coarse raster (20-100m, validation pending); EEA land-take indicators are aggregate stats only. Ground truth must be constructed and manually checked.

sources.name: Sentinel-2 (Copernicus Data Space Ecosystem)
sources.licence_quote: Sentinel data products are made available systematically and free of charge to all data users including the general public, scientific and commercial users.
sources.coverage_quote: Level 1C/L3 world coverage; Level 2A original ESA processing Europe only; 10/20/60m bands

sources.name: CLMS High Resolution Layer - Imperviousness (overview)
sources.licence_quote: principle of full, open and free access, as established by Commission Delegated Regulation (EU) No 1159/2013
sources.coverage_quote: Pan-European; EEA38 countries and the United Kingdom; 10m resolution density layers

sources.name: CLMS Imperviousness Density Change 2018-2021
sources.licence_quote: principle of full, open and free access, as established by Commission Delegated Regulation (EU) No 1159/2013
sources.coverage_quote: Spatial coverage: Europe; spatial resolution 20 m and 100 m; temporal extent 2018-2021
caveats_quoted: raster product identifies pixel-level changes, not individual parcels

sources.name: CORINE Land Cover (CLMS)
sources.licence_quote: principle of full, open and free access, as established by Commission Delegated Regulation (EU) No 1159/2013
sources.coverage_quote: Pan-European land cover/use inventory, 44 thematic classes, updated every six years
caveats_quoted: updated with new status and change layers every six years

sources.name: EuroCrops (pan-EU parcel-level crop type labels)
sources.coverage_quote: 17 EU countries: Austria, Belgium, Czechia, Germany, Denmark, Estonia, Spain, France, Croatia, Lithuania, Latvia, Netherlands, Portugal, Romania, Sweden, Slovenia, Slovakia
caveats_quoted: combines publicly available self-declared crop reporting datasets

sources.name: EEA Net Land Take in Cities indicator
sources.coverage_quote: EEA-38 member and cooperating countries; Urban Atlas Land Cover/Use Change, periods 2012-2018 and 2018-2021
caveats_quoted: output reports only summary statistics, not individual parcel identification
changes smaller than [MMU] thresholds are excluded

ground_truth.construction_protocol: Overlay EuroCrops/LPIS parcel boundaries on HRL Imperviousness Change plus multi-year Sentinel-2 NDVI/bare-soil time series to flag candidates; manually confirm true sealing vs temporary fallow via free high-res historical imagery (Google/Bing/national orthophotos) for a validation sample.

compute_path.platform: Google Earth Engine (Sentinel-2 SR) + Copernicus Data Space / WEkEO for CLMS rasters
compute_path.why: Sentinel-2 and CLMS rasters run natively on Google Earth Engine / Copernicus Data Space; no local GPU needed; parcel time-series analysis fits an 8-month part-time MacBook workflow.
